blocks.text: You can use the On-Demand scan option to run a scan instantly on any configured scan rule, regardless of resource type. Running an On-Demand scan does not affect the configured scan schedule. The next scheduled scan runs as planned after the On-Demand scan completes. To learn more, see About Scan Settings.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Scan Settings.
Click the Actions icon () for the scan rule you want to run.
The On-Demand Scan confirmation window appears.
Read the message that appears, then click Confirm.

blocks.text: The scan is initiated, and the results are displayed on the Resource Inventory page.
